CustomField.description: SCC-3386: Links this Trouble Ticket to the Incident record tracking the outage, when applicable. A direct lookup is used rather than a junction so the outage detail can be surfaced on the Work Order through cross-object formulas for the Field Service mobile app.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: SCC-3386: If this ticket is caused by a known outage, select the Incident tracking it so the field technician sees the outage detail.
CustomField.label: Related Outage
